plugin.note: Bring anti-dragon protection such as an anti-dragon shield and extended antifire. Baby black dragons in Taverley are fastest; brutal black dragons require 77 Slayer and use long-ranged dragonfire plus magic, so use Protect from Magic with crossbows or flinch with Dragon hunter lance.

requirements: Partial completion of Dragon Slayer I
Dragonfire protection for adult, brutal, and King Black Dragon kills
Dragon Slayer II for Corsair Cove Dungeon
Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Sir Amik Varze plus raw chicken for Evil Chicken's Lair
Song of the Elves for Mynydd
Wilderness risk for Lava Maze Dungeon, Wilderness Slayer Cave, and King Black Dragon approach
mechanics: Black dragons use melee and short-ranged dragonfire.
Baby black dragons do not use dragonfire.
Brutal black dragons use long-ranged dragonfire and a ranged magical attack.
Protect from Melee is recommended for standard Black dragons.
Protect from Magic is recommended for Brutal black dragons.
Dragonfire protection should be used against standard, brutal, and King Black Dragon variants.
The King Black Dragon lair itself is not Wilderness, but access is through the Wilderness.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Choose fast baby black dragons, profitable brutal black dragons, standard black dragons, or King Black Dragon based on requirements and risk.
recommendedFor: choosing speed, profit, or boss alternative
steps: Confirm partial Dragon Slayer I completion before assignment.
Use dragonfire protection for any non-baby black dragon.
Use baby black dragons in Taverley Dungeon for fastest low-effort task completion.
Use brutal black dragons with 77 Slayer when profit matters.
Avoid bringing valuable risk to Wilderness routes and King Black Dragon approach.
notes: Most profitable variants are slower than baby black dragons.
Black dragons have multiple quest-gated alternative locations.

methods.label: Baby black dragons
methods.summary: Kill baby black dragons in the Taverley task-only area for fast completion.
steps: Go to the Taverley Dungeon task-only area.
Use the five baby black dragon spawns in the grouped task-only area.
AFK where practical to quickly complete the assignment.
Use the bridge safespot if desired.
notes: Baby black dragons do not use dragonfire.
They drop only baby dragon bones.

methods.label: Normal black dragons
methods.summary: Use standard black dragons when location access or banking convenience matters more than fastest completion.
steps: Use Protect from Melee and dragonfire protection.
Use Corsair Cove Dungeon for the closest standard dragons to a bank with a Mythical cape teleport.
Use Evil Chicken's Lair after starting Freeing Sir Amik Varze and bringing a raw chicken.
Avoid Mynydd unless specifically assigned or desired because it is far from a bank and has one spawn.
notes: Standard black dragons hit accurately and relatively hard.
Taverley Dungeon lower level has two adult dragon spawns.

methods.label: Brutal black dragons
methods.summary: Kill brutal black dragons for generous drops after 77 Slayer.
steps: Stand out of melee range.
Use Protect from Magic against the ranged magical attack.
Use the strongest available crossbow, with Dragon hunter crossbow as best.
Keep dragonfire protection active.
For faster melee methods, keep Protect from Magic active and use flinching to avoid accurate melee attacks.
notes: Brutal black dragons have long-ranged dragonfire.
Dragon hunter lance or other melee can be faster with flinching.

methods.label: Wilderness options
methods.summary: Use Lava Maze Dungeon or Wilderness Slayer Cave only when accepting Wilderness risk.
requiredOrKeyItems: One-click teleport such as royal seed pod
Poison protection for Lava Maze Dungeon
steps: Use Wilderness Slayer Cave for easier access than Lava Maze Dungeon.
Safespot Wilderness Slayer Cave dragons and keep a one-click teleport such as royal seed pod ready.
Use Lava Maze Dungeon only when prepared for the long route, knife web cuts, and poison spiders.
Avoid risking items you are unwilling to lose.
notes: Wilderness Slayer Cave is multicombat and a popular player killing spot.
A royal seed pod or other one-click teleport is useful for Wilderness Slayer Cave, but players must safespot the dragons.
Lava Maze Dungeon is troublesome without 82 Agility.

methods.label: King Black Dragon alternative
methods.summary: Kill King Black Dragon for a boss alternative, but treat the Wilderness approach as high risk.
steps: Do not bring items you are unwilling to lose.
Use the short route from level 44 Wilderness Obelisk to the KBD lair lever.
Enter the lair, which is not itself Wilderness.
Follow the dedicated King Black Dragon strategy for boss mechanics.
notes: The Wilderness approach is a popular player killing spot.
Escape is likely impossible if attacked by a player killer near the lair approach.
Choose the named monster in the catalogue to use its dedicated strategy, equipment, location and preparation requirements.
